about: The basement's choices the drawing leaves open, as design.json is for the project floor: heights, which rooms are styled, what each room is for and how it meets the street. The plan itself (walls, openings, rooms) comes only from the traced data file.

floor.about: Under the lobby (D89): the shared machines and the library, a storey below the street.

light_wells.about: Dug down along the street sides, so the high windows see the sky: 2.4 m across, their floors under the sills.

rooms.LIBRARY: library: a book on the shelves for each piece of third-party code the company uses or has looked at; nothing here installs or runs it
rooms.WEST MACHINE ROOM: machine: one shared machine in its rack, lit when it is on and busy when a job runs
rooms.LIFT AND STAIRS: between floors: the way up to the lobby and every project's floor

closed_doors: every door into a room that is not styled stays shut

sun.about: The same moment as the floors above (out/sun.json). Below the street the low sun reaches only the tops of the high windows; the rooms are lit by their own lamps.

moment.about: Mid-afternoon, nobody down here: the machines at work on their own.

finish.about: The walls' and ceiling's hand-finished plaster: its tone wanders this much either way (materials.plaster). plaster_tone: the walls' paint (warm white below ground).
